stories.title: The Asian financial crisis, 1997–98
stories.summary: How the 1997–98 crisis cut imports in Thailand, Korea and Indonesia by a third, and turned their trade deficits into surpluses.

stories.title: The great trade collapse, 2008–09
stories.summary: How the global financial crisis cut world goods trade by a third in a few months, month by month.

stories.title: The euro area debt crisis, 2010–13
stories.summary: Greece, Spain, Portugal and Italy cut imports, swung their current accounts into surplus and paid with record unemployment, 2010–13.

stories.title: The oil price collapse, 2014–16
stories.summary: When Brent crude fell from $112 to $31 a barrel, 2014–16, the export earnings of oil producers halved.

stories.title: The US–China trade war, 2018–24
stories.summary: Tariffs from 2018 cut US imports from China, sent Chinese soybean buyers to Brazil, and moved supply chains to Mexico and Vietnam.

stories.title: COVID-19 and world trade, 2020–21
stories.summary: Month by month: world exports fell by a quarter in April–May 2020, then rebounded to records within a year.

stories.title: Russian oil turns east, 2021–24
stories.summary: How sanctions redirected Russia's crude oil exports from Europe to China and India, using trade-by-product data.

stories.title: Europe's energy crisis, 2022–24
stories.summary: When Russia cut pipeline gas in 2022, the EU's gas import bill nearly tripled and its trade surplus became a record deficit.

stories.title: US tariffs, 2025
stories.summary: Importers rushed ahead of new US tariffs, then imports from China fell by over 40% while Taiwan, China and Vietnam gained.

stories.title: The Belt and Road Initiative, 2013–24
stories.summary: Trade, loans and investment between China and the 156 countries on the official partner list, before and after 2013.

stories.title: China's rise as an exporter, 1995–2024
stories.summary: A Compare-view story: what goes with exporting more, and how China climbed from 6th-largest exporter to 1st.

stories.title: What China sells and buys, 1995–2024
stories.summary: Product by product: China's exports moved from clothing to machinery and cars, and its imports from machines to oil and iron ore.

stories.title: Wars and oil exporters, 1990–2015
stories.summary: Kuwait, Iraq, Libya and Yemen: how invasion, sanctions and civil war cut the exports of economies that live on oil, and which ones recovered.

stories.title: War in Ukraine, 2022–24
stories.summary: Exports halved in the first months of Russia's invasion; grain found new routes, steel collapsed and the EU became Ukraine's main market.

stories.title: Is the world getting better?
stories.summary: Thirty years of longer lives, fewer child deaths, less extreme poverty and more electricity, and rising CO2 emissions.
